c.title: $5,200 / 3br - Lovely coach house (Kitsilano)
c.description:
Lovely home, approx 1500 plus sq ft. three bedroom, 2.5 bathroom and attached one car garage.
This is a seperate detached, stand alone house.
Central location at 7th and Balsam.
Open floor plan,
Kitchen has gas stove, bosch dishwasher. Quartz countertops,
Cozy fireplace,
infloor radiant hotwater heat( very efficient)
Upstairs 3 bedrooms with vaulted ceilings and upstairs laundry.
Fenced in front yard and a front porch.
Location is walking distance to shops on 4th and Broadway, close to Kitsilano High, and minutes to UBC or downtown.
Available now or Oct 15.
Pets welcome with approval.
Non smokers inside or out only.
